title: Hot Wheels Racing (2025)
summary: 200px|rightHot Wheels Racing is a series introduced in 2025, intended as Hot Wheels's marketing umbrella for track sets and similar products marketing Formula One cars. The series was introduced in 2025 as part of a tie-in with Hot Wheels and Formula One Management. As of 2026, the only products sold under this umbrella are track sets, themed to various aspects of a Formula One race weekend.

title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks
summary: right|200pxHot Wheels Monster Trucks is a monster truck series introduced by Mattel in 2018 as the successor to Mattel's long-running Monster Jam toy line. The series features original Hot Wheels designs, monster truck versions of classic Hot Wheels vehicles, licensed vehicles, and trucks featured in Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live.

title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Mutant Chaos & Car Slime Set
summary: The 2026 Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Mutant Chaos & Car Slime Set (JTP60) was released in late-2026. All 18 cars were made in Thailand. The set includes two 8-ounce jars of play slime.
